recommendation: Keep this fix; it completes the FHIR-5871 application for generated primitive profile descriptions without altering regex behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-5871 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core datatypes. It reported that time and dateTime descriptions implied seconds were optional while the regexes required seconds, and the accepted resolution was to update the descriptions in SVN revision 4536.
initial_application: Commit af82109a5f (#5871/SVN r4536) updated source/datatypes.html for dateTime and time to say seconds must be provided due to schema type constraints and may be zero-filled/ignored. The current narrative datatype table still has that rule, and source/datatypes/primitives.xml already had equivalent dateTime wording.
additional_context: The active primitive spreadsheet source still described time only as 'A time during the day, with no date specified' even though the time regex requires hh:mm:ss. That source feeds generated primitive StructureDefinitions such as time.profile.json, so the gap affected a current conformance surface. FHIR-16948 later clarified receiver discretion for the same sentence and was reconciled separately.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/primitives.xml so the time primitive description states the hh:mm:ss format and the required-seconds rule.
source_changes: source/datatypes/primitives.xml: updated the time primitive description to include hh:mm:ss and required-seconds wording.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the same seconds wording by adding that ignoring seconds is at receiver discretion.
